name: Iron
instruction: Can you create a 3D model of an iron? The iron should have a flat soleplate with steam holes. Add a handle on top with a dial for temperature control. Include a water tank with a fill cap. Add buttons for steam and spray functions. Make sure the power cord is visible.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is an iron.
The iron has a flat soleplate.
The handle is positioned on top of the iron.
The water tank is integrated into the design.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The handle is proportionate to the body of the iron.
The water tank is appropriately sized relative to the iron's body.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The soleplate is positioned flat against the surface.
The handle is securely attached to the top of the iron.
The water tank is positioned at the back or side of the iron.
The buttons for steam and spray functions are easily accessible.
Object distance and contact: The soleplate does not overlap with the handle.
There is a clear space between the water tank and the soleplate.
The power cord is visibly connected without obstruction.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The steam holes are included in the soleplate.
The temperature control dial is present on the handle.
Buttons for steam and spray functions are included.
